# archive , records, not rules

Moved here 2026-08-07 on owner decision 8 ("one canon file per concern, everything else a pointer,
dated reports archived", and "make it so it acc gets archived and evrth like acc gate for that so it
forces").

**Why this exists.** These 17 entries sat in the same directory as live law, so a fresh session
reading `_design-system/` could not tell a frozen 2026-07 audit from a rule it must follow. Two of
them, `CANON.md` and `CONTRADICTIONS.md`, still claimed authority they had already lost. That is the
whole failure: history shelved next to law reads as law.

**The rule for what belongs here:** a file is archive-bound when it is a record of a moment rather
than an instruction for the next one. A dated audit, a superseded reconciliation, a triage list
whose findings have landed, a one-off receipt. If a file tells you what to DO, it does not belong
here.

**What moved, and where its live answer now lives**

| Archived | Read instead |
|---|---|
| CANON.md, CONTRADICTIONS.md, V2_RECONCILIATION.md | LOCKFILE.md for frozen values, SOURCE.md for applied law |
| CONSISTENCY_AUDIT.md, CONSOLIDATION_2026-07-12.md, DESIGN_GOVERNANCE_AUDIT_2026-07-10.md | CANON_PLAN.md for the current structure |
| _compliance-receipts.md, _dashboard-triage.md, _geometry-triage.md, _spacing-drift.md, _overnight-run-summary.md, _icons-to-make.md | the ledgers: DRIFT_LEDGER.md, REMOVED.md, TASTE_LOG.md |
| PHOTO_STRATEGY.md | SOURCE.md imagery section, and the FLOORS LAW imagery floor in CLAUDE.md |
| _diagnosis/, _discovery-audit/, _video-audit/, sections/ | research/ for evidence, components/ for per-component rules |

Three inbound pointers were repointed in the same move (the project CLAUDE.md, and two global
doctrine files), so nothing cites a path that stopped existing.
